cd /private/tmp/lightclaw-diagnosis-live-20261021/slot-host-0/workspace/task && md5 scratch/config.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, collections
p='scratch/config.json'
raw=open(p,'rb').read()
d=json.loads(raw.decode('utf-8'), object_pairs_hook=collections.OrderedDict)
s=d['service']
new=collections.OrderedDict()
for k,v in s.items():
    if k=='timeout':
        new[k]=45
        new['retries']=2
    else:
        new[k]=v
if 'retries' not in new:
    new['retries']=2
d['service']=new
with open('scratch/config-new.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(d,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
EOF
cat scratch/config-new.json; md5 scratch/config.json; python3 -c "import json;print(json.load(open('scratch/config-new.json')))"
